centre.name: Ruth And Naomi’S Mission
centre.address: 46130 Margaret Ave, Chilliwack, BC V2P 4Z1, Canada

about_blocks.text: The Step-Inn Shelter and the Step-Up Residential Recovery Centre are operated by the Ruth & Naomi’s Mission which is a Registered Non-Profit Society and Assisted Living Facility in British Columbia to provide faith-based abstinence and recovery services to individuals who suffer from alcoholism, drug addiction and other life-controlling issues. The two distinct yet integrated programs provide supportive housing for up to 34 men and women who are in recovery. The facility provides a structured environment and staff to support residents in their recovery; first, recovery of their lives, and then to help in their reintegration into the community, work place, back to school, or into other life-giving options. The centre provides a safe, healthy and nonjudgmental environment where residents are respected, acknowledged and recognized for who they are. Services are designed to encourage the development of new coping mechanisms, support networks, healthy lifestyles and independence, all within an alcohol and drug-free environment.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
